faq1q: What should I do if I find a leak?
faq1a: If it is safe, turn off the stopcock and avoid using the affected installation. Contact a professional to identify the source.
faq2q: Can I get a quote before the work starts?
faq2a: Yes. Describe the issue and confirm the scope and cost before work begins.
faq3q: Do you work on bathrooms and kitchens?
faq3a: This demo covers common bathroom and kitchen plumbing repairs and installations. The final services should reflect the professional’s actual work.
